title: Jev Typeahead Rerank, Off the Keystroke Path
description: Measured on production: with a 150 ms per-keystroke budget, 0 of 72 Jev calls were ranked and each still added about 152 ms. Given room to finish, Jev puts the right page first 12/12 against the deterministic 10/12. Type in the box and flip between the old blocking design and the new one: deterministic suggestions paint at once, the call goes out on a 450 ms pause with a 1000 ms budget, and any answer whose query you already typed past is discarded.
